title: status.yaml
description: Every tracked departure from the reference (ADR 0007), one row each. A row without `word` concerns the whole test case; a row with `word` records the answer the reference should give. PROTOCOL.md section 12.

case.description: The test case's id: its directory path.

word.description: A word of the test case; absent for a row about the whole test case.

ref.description: The upstream issue or pull request: owner/repo#number or jira:KEY-123.

head.description: A pr's full 40-hex head commit the rows depend on.

affects.description: engine: the reference lacks the behaviour. loader: only FieldWorks HCLoader lacks it.

intended.description: The answer the reference should give; required on a word row.
